column1: # Tier-2 routing eval cases.  <prompt>\t<expected>
# expected = exact skill/agent name the router should pick, or "none".
# Tab-separated. Lines starting with # are ignored.
# Focus: the trigger collisions tightened in the skill/agent cleanup.
# --- monitoring-engineer (Go observability) ---
Instrument this Go service with Prometheus metrics and OpenTelemetry traces
Add dd-trace-go APM spans to our Go HTTP handlers
# --- kubernetes-specialist (workloads, debugging, chart and manifest authoring) ---
My pods are crashlooping, help me debug the deployment
Scaffold a new Helm chart for my web app
Generate a Kubernetes Deployment and Service manifest from scratch
# --- architecture-designer (absorbed cloud-architect) ---
Design the system architecture and write an ADR for our new microservice
Design a multi-region AWS VPC with public/private subnets and least-privilege IAM
Plan a cloud migration from on-prem to Azure using the 6Rs framework
# --- writing-adrs (authoring the ADR doc, vs designing in architecture-designer) ---
Draft an ADR in our house format recording the decision to adopt GitLab CI/CD components
Write up this decision as an ADR for the platform team
Review my ADR draft for format and writing style
# --- devex-writer (tighten/review prose, vs authoring ADR or designing) ---
This roadmap section is too wordy, tighten it without losing meaning
Trim the fluff in our platform strategy doc and cut the repetition across sections
Make this DevEx golden-path guide more concise
# --- baseline single-owner routes ---
Create an Airflow DAG that runs daily and loads data to S3
Store this API key securely in Azure Key Vault
Build a Cobra CLI with a Bubbletea TUI
Set up golden paths and a self-service developer portal
Write a Temporal workflow with saga compensation
# --- should NOT trigger any skill ---
What's the capital of France?
Tell me a joke about databases
Show me the last 10 commits
What changed in this file?
# --- eng-manager (people leadership) — guards "performance"/"team" collisions ---
Structure my first one-to-one with a new report
My senior engineer is underperforming — help me start a PIP
Improve the performance of this slow Postgres query
Our team's pods are crashlooping in production
# --- gitlab-engineer (CI/CD authoring) vs gitlab (glab ops) collision ---
Write a .gitlab-ci.yml with SAST and a reusable secret-detection component
Set up hosted runners on our GitLab Dedicated instance
Build a CI/CD component and publish it to the catalog
Create a merge request from my current branch
Check the status of the last pipeline run and show failing job logs
# --- copier (template authoring + consume) ---
Write a copier.yml to scaffold a Go service with conditional questions
How do I update an existing project when its Copier template changes?
Add a _migrations entry to my Copier template for a breaking rename
Scaffold a new repo from our Copier template
# --- devex-reviewer (consumer persona evaluation) vs devex-writer (prose tightening) ---
Review this blueprint doc from the consumer's perspective
Evaluate the golden path docs through backend and cloud engineer personas
Run a friction review on our generated repo's CONTRIBUTING
Review this ADR from a devex perspective — will app teams understand the impact?
This roadmap is too wordy, tighten it
# --- devex-persona-* standalone routes ---
Review create-a-repo.md as a backend developer who just cloned the repo
Evaluate the infra docs as a cloud engineer who needs to run tofu plan locally
Review the manifest reference as a tech lead writing a manifest for the first time
Check whether the bun scaffold path is documented as well as the Java path
Review this pipeline from an SRE debugging perspective
# --- cc-spex base vs lane skills vs jira-intake vs spex agent ---
Set up spec-kit and the spex plugin in this repo
Which spex extensions should I enable, and why does the review-spec hook not fire?
Spec out this new feature with spec-kit: brainstorm first, then specify
Run plan and tasks for the spec we just wrote
Fix this bug: the login endpoint returns 500 when the email contains a plus sign
This test started failing after yesterday's merge, find and fix the regression
Should we move our packages from Nexus to the GitLab package registry? Assess it before we spec anything
Roll the new LTS CI template out to 120 repos in batches with a rollback plan
Pull Jira epic ABC-123 with its stories and comments and draft questions for the product owner
Do the groundwork on ticket ABC-77 in the background and report back which lane it is
Design the target architecture for moving our services to event-driven messaging
# guards: lane skills must not swallow generic debugging, brainstorming or strategy work
Why does this test fail? Just explain the cause, don't change anything
Brainstorm ideas for a small personal CLI tool, no spec-kit involved
Write the platform strategy document for next year
# --- harness-engineer (Harness.io) vs gitlab-engineer / platform-engineer / terraform-specialist ---
Write a Harness pipeline with a CI stage and a canary Kubernetes deploy stage
Create a Harness stage template and reference it from two pipelines
Why does my Harness delegate not pick up this connector?
Write a Harness IDP self-service workflow that triggers an onboarding pipeline
Use the harness Terraform provider to create a project and a GitHub connector
Compare Backstage and Port for our developer portal strategy
